# opal_paladin (Data Source)

Paladin DataSource

## Example Usage

```terraform
data "opal_paladin" "my_paladin" {
  id = "32acc112-21ff-4669-91c2-21e27683eaa1"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `id` (String) The ID of the Paladin. Use this value as a reviewer in a request configuration's service_user_ids.

### Read-Only

- `admin_view_only` (Boolean) When true, the Paladin's recommendations are visible only to admins. Only meaningful when monitor_mode is true.
- `enabled_connectors` (List of String) The connectors the Paladin is allowed to use.
- `instructions` (String) The free-form instructions that guide the Paladin's decisions.
- `monitor_mode` (Boolean) When true, the Paladin reasons about requests but takes no action. Shown as "Monitor mode" in the UI.
- `name` (String) The name of the Paladin.
- `owner_id` (String) The ID of the owner of the Paladin.
